questions.stem: 晚上在溪邊追螢火蟲（fireflies），對現在的孩子來說已經不再是常見的活動。
questions.answer: Chasing fireflies by streams at night is no longer a common activity for children nowadays.
accepted_answers: For today's children, chasing fireflies along streams at night is no longer a common activity.
Chasing fireflies near streams in the evening is no longer a common activity for kids today.

questions.stem: 當受污染的溪流變乾淨時，居民小時候常看到的螢火蟲（fireflies）就會回來。

accepted_answers: When the polluted streams are clean again, the fireflies which local residents often saw in their childhood will return.

patterns: 形容詞子句（關係代名詞當受詞）

1.explanation_zh: 主詞是「晚上在溪邊追螢火蟲」這個動作，英文用動名詞片語 Chasing fireflies by streams at night，視為單數，動詞用 is。「已經不再是」用 is no longer（或 is not … anymore）。「現在的孩子」寫 children nowadays 或 today's children；nowadays 是副詞，不能放在名詞前面。activity 是可數名詞，「常見的活動」寫 a common activity。
evidence: 已經不再是常見的活動
1.strategy_zh: 動作當主詞就用 V-ing 開頭、動詞用單數；「不再」用 no longer，放在 be 動詞後面。
hints: 切成四段：晚上在溪邊追螢火蟲（fireflies）／對現在的孩子來說／已經不再是／常見的活動
標的詞彙：chase（追逐，L2）、stream（溪流，L2）、night（晚上，L1）、common（常見的，L1）、activity（活動，L2）、child（孩子，L1）
句型框架：V-ing … + is no longer + a + adj. + N + for …

2.explanation_zh: 「當…時」是時間副詞子句，用 When + 現在式（不加 will）表示未來；「受污染的溪流」用過去分詞當形容詞 the polluted streams。「居民小時候常看到的螢火蟲」中文修飾語在前，英文先寫 the fireflies，後面接形容詞子句 (which) residents often saw as children；子句說的是過去的事，用過去式 saw，受格關係代名詞可以省略。主要子句「就會回來」用 will come back。
evidence: 當受污染的溪流變乾淨時
居民小時候常看到的螢火蟲（fireflies）就會回來
2.strategy_zh: 「當…時」子句用現在式代替未來式；「…的＋名詞」修飾語很長時，名詞放前面，後面接 which／that 子句。
hints: 切成四段：當受污染的溪流／變乾淨時／居民小時候常看到的螢火蟲（fireflies）／就會回來
標的詞彙：polluted（受污染的，L3）、stream（溪流，L2）、clean（乾淨的，L1）、resident（居民，L5）、child（孩子，L1）、come back（回來）
句型框架：When + S + V(現在式), the + N + (which／that) + S + V-ed … + will + VR

traps.zh: 居民小時候常看到的螢火蟲（fireflies）
traps.literal_error: When the polluted streams become clean, the residents often saw as children fireflies will come back.
traps.explanation_zh: 「居民小時候常看到的螢火蟲」照中文語序把修飾語放在名詞前面是錯的；英文先寫 the fireflies，再接 which／that 子句。

traps.literal_error: When the pollution streams become clean, the fireflies which residents often saw as children will come back.
traps.explanation_zh: 「受污染的」修飾名詞要用形容詞（過去分詞）polluted；pollution 是名詞。

bonus.text: Only when the polluted streams become clean will the fireflies which residents often saw as children come back.
bonus.explanation_zh: 強調「只有溪流變乾淨，螢火蟲才會回來」時，可用 Only when … 放句首、主要子句倒裝（will the fireflies … come back）；這是加分寫法，一般寫法就能得滿分。

2.restructuring_zh: 「居民小時候常看到的螢火蟲」是放在名詞前面的長修飾語；英文先寫 the fireflies，再接形容詞子句 (which／that) residents often saw as children。
2.notes_zh: 「受污染的溪流」the polluted streams／stream、polluted rivers 都可以；「變乾淨」become／get clean、be clean again 都給分，時間子句不加 will；「居民」residents、local residents、local people 都可以；「小時候」as children、when they were young／kids、in their childhood 都給分；「常看到」often saw 或 used to see，關係代名詞 which／that 可省略；「就會回來」will come back 或 will return。

1.translation: Chasing fireflies by streams at night is no longer a common activity for children today.
1.explanation_zh: 主詞「晚上在溪邊追螢火蟲」是一個動作，用動名詞片語 Chasing fireflies … 當主詞，動詞用單數 is；「已經不再是」用 no longer；「對現在的孩子來說」用 for children today（也可 today's children）。

2.translation: When the polluted streams become clean, the fireflies that residents often saw in their childhood will return.
2.explanation_zh: 「當…時」用 when 子句，表未來的時間子句用現在式 become；「受污染的溪流」用過去分詞 polluted 放名詞前；「居民小時候常看到的螢火蟲」用 that 關係子句修飾 fireflies，子句內是過去的事用過去式 saw；「就會回來」用 will return。

issues_zh: 三個參考譯文都沒問題；但加分寫法 Only when the polluted streams become clean will the fireflies … come back 把語意改成「只有當溪流變乾淨，螢火蟲才會回來」，多了中文沒有的「唯一條件」限定。原句「當…時，…就會回來」只是條件與結果，建議改用不改變語意的加分寫法（例如 Once the polluted streams become clean, the fireflies … will come back，或用 used to see 的關係子句），或在說明裡註明 only when 會加重語氣、稍微偏離原意。

problems: 第 2 題驗證者對參考譯文有意見（warn）：三個參考譯文都沒問題；但加分寫法 Only when the polluted streams become clean will the fireflies … come back 把語意改成「只有當溪流變乾淨，螢火蟲才會回來」，多了中文

1.translation: Chasing fireflies by the stream at night is no longer a common activity for children today.
1.explanation_zh: 「追螢火蟲」當主詞用動名詞 Chasing fireflies；「已經不再是」用 is no longer；「對現在的孩子來說」用 for children today。

2.translation: When polluted streams become clean again, the fireflies that residents often saw in their childhood will come back.
2.explanation_zh: 「當…變乾淨時」用 When 副詞子句，現在式代替未來；主要子句用 will come back；「居民小時候常看到的螢火蟲」用關係子句 that residents often saw in their childhood 修飾 fireflies。
